resources.string: Vellum uses the microphone only when you tap record in a classroom notebook, to transcribe the lesson live with on-device speech recognition. Audio is processed on this device and never uploaded. You can deny and keep writing notes normally.

While classroom recording runs, Vellum shows a persistent notification so you always know the microphone is active, with a Stop action. Allow notifications on Android 13 and above to keep this visible.
Microphone permission denied — classroom recording is unavailable. You can still write notes normally.
